verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs publish OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs inline on each endpoint reference page (e.g., specs/2026-09/account-account-info-v2026-09.json), so machine-readable specs exist per endpoint. However, probes found no consolidated spec at the standard openapi.json/swagger.json paths. That is not a contradiction, since those paths were never documented, but no single downloadable full-API spec is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented single downloadable OpenAPI file covering the whole API, documented download/location instructions, and independent hands-on confirmation that the per-endpoint spec files can be fetched.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Every endpoint reference page publishes its machine-readable spec inline ("## OpenAPI ... specs/2026-09/account-account-info-v2026-09.json GET /account-info/2026-09/details openapi: 3.0.1")
